purpose: Validate whether the training-dynamics response framework extends from DATA perturbation to an OPTIMIZER-INPUT perturbation channel: multiplicative log-LR of the frozen AdamW schedule, u = log(eta/eta0). NOT a final LR controller.

frozen_science_semantics.input_channel: eta_k(u) = eta_k * exp(u), applied at EVERY optimizer step k=1..H of the H-step future rollout (persistent schedule input, not one-shot pulse)
frozen_science_semantics.delta_rule: frozen before any GPU; tuning delta by results is FORBIDDEN

theory.forward: theta+ = (1 - lr*wd)*theta - lr*adaptive(c)  [decoupled weight decay INCLUDED]
theory.u_channel: d theta+/du = lr * (-adaptive(c) - wd*theta)  [chain rule: d lr/du = lr at u=0]
theory.h_eta: <v_H, S>, S = sum_k T_k e_u(k); T_k = frozen per-step tangent transition (clipping transpose + fp32 future HVP); pulse enters via dc channel: clipped(c + u e) -> dm1=(1-b1) u e, dv1=2(1-b2) c u e

frozen_science_semantics.fd_reference: (L(+delta) - L(-delta)) / (2 delta), L = V_score at endpoint theta_{t+H}(u)

gates.S1: pooled Pearson |r|(h_eta, FD) >= 0.8 AND sign accuracy >= 0.9 across all cells
gates.S1_fail_action: STOP; report failure; do NOT proceed to Stage 2

metrics: regret = selected loss - optimal realized loss
prediction calibration (Pearson h_eta vs realized slope)

frozen_environment.recipe: e3c v0.7 identical to A0K/A0L/A0N; states from v0.7 bank (seeds 2030/2031/2037 x steps 46/52/64/82)
frozen_environment.lookahead: A0K frozen live_manifest events (read-only) reused as the future stream

questions: Q1: does an LR-input response exist (S1 gate)?
Q2: is it more informative than random/fixed adjustment (Stage 2 vs null)?
Q3: does it add a control dimension beyond the data response?
stop_condition: report and stop; do not auto-launch any next round; no Stage 3 unless explicitly authorized later
